instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: Coordinator briefing: Volunteer Applicants provide their service interests and available days. Orientation Facilitators record attendance and safety-briefing completion, and the Volunteer Coordinator marks an applicant eligible only after both records exist. The Placement Lead assigns an eligible applicant to one service team, after which the applicant confirms or declines. The briefing does not explain whether service interests affect the team assignment.

output.summary: The workflow collects service interests and available days from Volunteer Applicants, records orientation attendance and safety-briefing completion, and permits eligibility marking only after both readiness records exist. A Placement Lead assigns an eligible applicant to one service team, and the applicant then confirms or declines. The briefing leaves the role of service interests in team assignment unresolved.
output.primary_goal: Coordinate applicant readiness, eligibility, and assignment to one service team.
key_capabilities: Collect service interests and available days.
Record orientation attendance and safety-briefing completion.
Mark applicants eligible only after both readiness records exist.
Assign an eligible applicant to one service team.
unresolved_points: Whether service interests affect the team assignment.
